subject: Procurement onboarding kickoff — due diligence & supplier diversity packet
messages:
From: Karthis Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kofi Mensah <k.mensah@africatech.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement onboarding kickoff — due diligence & supplier diversity packet

Hi Kofi,

Great to meet you today. As discussed, we need to kick off the formal procurement onboarding so we can get a purchase order (PO) in place and enable initial billing. To keep things moving I attached the core forms we typically collect for new vendors:

- Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf (basic company profile, tax IDs)
- Supplier_Diversity_Questionnaire.xlsx (self-identification fields + certifications)
- Modern_Slavery_Statement.docx (policy & attestation)

Can you please:
1) Complete the Vendor Onboarding Form and the Supplier Diversity Questionnaire
2) Upload a copy of your bank details and beneficiary name for wire setup (bank_details.pdf is fine)
3) Attach any government or third-party minority/women-owned certificates if applicable

High-level timeline: if we receive the completed packet by EOD Thu (26 Mar), procurement can issue a PO the following week. If you need a quicker turnaround let me know and I can loop in Procurement and Legal to expedite.

Two quick notes:
- Our standard PO terms are Net-30 by default; special terms require Legal approval
- For vendors outside the US we sometimes require a W-8BEN or local tax form for our records

CCing Monica (our procurement lead) to confirm any policy questions on the ESG/modern slavery fields.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you onboarded.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf; Supplier_Diversity_Questionnaire.xlsx; Modern_Slavery_Statement.docx

From: Kofi Mensah <k.mensah@africatech.io>
To: Karthis Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@africatech.io
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 14:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Procurement onboarding kickoff — due diligence & supplier diversity packet

Hi Karthik / Monica,

Thanks for the packet — we received everything. I've filled out the vendor profile and attached our preliminary docs: AfricaTech_Vendor_Profile.pdf and bank_details.pdf. Our team will complete the Supplier Diversity Questionnaire by Wednesday (24 Mar).

A couple of clarifying questions:
- Does Redwood have a minimum ESG score or specific red flags on the modern slavery statement you can share?
- Are copies of third-party audit reports (if we had them) required at this stage, or only on request?

We are a privately held Ghanaian company; we can provide a Minority_Ownership_Certificate (digital copy attached) and some governance docs if helpful. If anything requires signatures I can route them back via DocuSign.

Appreciate the quick start.

Regards,
Kofi Mensah
Head of Operations | AfricaTech
k.mensah@africatech.io
Attachments: AfricaTech_Vendor_Profile.pdf; bank_details.pdf; Minority_Ownership_Certificate.pdf

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kofi Mensah <k.mensah@africatech.io>, Karthis Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Mar 2026 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement onboarding kickoff — due diligence & supplier diversity packet

Thanks Kofi — that's helpful. A few operational items and expectations from Procurement: 

- Modern slavery statement: we ask vendors to affirm no forced labor and provide the policy doc. We do not require 3rd-party audit reports by default, but we'll flag if any responses trigger a deeper review.
- Supplier diversity: please complete the self-ID fields in the spreadsheet and attach your Minority_Ownership_Certificate.pdf. If you are minority-owned at >=25% we record that and may surface it as part of our supplier diversity program.
- Banking: bank_details.pdf is fine, but we will also need a signed banking authorization page if your banking institution requests it.
- Tax forms: since you're an international vendor, our tax team will request a W-8 or local equivalent during onboarding.

Next steps (recommended):
1) Kofi: complete the Supplier_Diversity_Questionnaire.xlsx and return by 24 Mar
2) Karthik: open a ProcureNow ticket so Procurement can track the PO and banking 
3) Rishi (Legal): please confirm if we need any additional contractual language for cross-border suppliers under $250k ARR 

On Sun, Mar 22, 2026 at 14:45 +0000, Kofi Mensah <k.mensah@africatech.io> wrote:
> Thanks for the packet — we received everything. I've filled out the vendor profile and attached our preliminary docs...

Monica Patel

monica_patel@redwoodinference.com
+1 (650) 555-0147

Attachments referenced: Supplier_Diversity_Questionnaire.xlsx

From: Kofi Mensah <k.mensah@africatech.io>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthis Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Mar 2026 16:20:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Procurement onboarding kickoff — due diligence & supplier diversity packet

Monica / Karthik,

Completed the diversity questionnaire and attached it here (final version). A few answers/details:
- Ownership: 40% minority-owned by founding partners (details in Minority_Ownership_Certificate.pdf)
- Modern slavery: We have a published policy; I attached a signed statement and our HR escalation contact.
- Audits: We do not have a formal third-party ESG audit yet; we are open to providing additional evidence if required during a deeper review.

On commercial terms: our standard is Net-45 for international customers — would Redwood consider Net-45 or do we need Legal approval for Net-45? We can also accept Net-30 if that simplifies the process.

Attachments: Supplier_Diversity_Questionnaire_filled.xlsx; Modern_Slavery_Statement_signed.pdf

Thanks,
Kofi

From: Karthis Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kofi Mensah <k.mensah@africatech.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 10:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement onboarding kickoff — due diligence & supplier diversity packet

Thanks Kofi — and thanks Monica & Rishi for the quick responses.

We're aligned to proceed. Monica, can you open the ProcureNow ticket and attach the completed questionnaire and bank details? I've created a HubSpot record for tracking: HS-42319 and added the deal ID RDW-2026-0174.

Legal / Rishi — can you confirm whether Net-45 is acceptable for this supplier size (vendor projected first-year spend ~$48k) and if any cross-border clauses are required? If not, we will proceed with Redwood_PO_Template.xlsx and request Net-30 standard terms.

Kofi — once procurement confirms the PO timing we will share the PO number and next steps for invoices. Expect an email from procure@redwoodinference.com with the official PO and onboarding link.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — welcome aboard.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_PO_Template.xlsx
